hazard_types.description: A high-intensity burst of stellar radiation scorches everything in its path.

status_effect.description: Solar radiation jams sensors — fog of war vision halved.

aristotle.mitigated: The shields hold. Aristotle breathes a sigh of relief — hull repairs are expensive.
aristotle.failed: The flare slams into the hull. Aristotle curses at the repair bill.

dave.mitigated: Shields absorb the blast. Dave nods — training pays off.
dave.failed: Solar fire rakes the hull. Dave grits his teeth and checks damage reports.

hazard_types.description: A dense cloud of tumbling rock and debris tears through the flight path.

aristotle.mitigated: The navigator threads through the debris like silk. Aristotle purrs with approval.
aristotle.failed: Rocks hammer the hull. Aristotle winces at every impact.

dave.mitigated: Expert piloting weaves them through unscathed. Dave exhales slowly.
dave.failed: Asteroids clip the hull. Dave braces against the console as sparks fly.

hazard_types.description: A shimmering nebula of anti-magic energy that drains whisper crystal fuel.

status_effect.description: Mana void siphons whisper crystals — losing 1 crystal every 10 seconds.

aristotle.mitigated: Fairy wards flare — the void parts harmlessly around the ship.
aristotle.failed: The void latches on. Aristotle watches the crystal gauge drop with horror.

dave.mitigated: Arcane countermeasures neutralise the void. The crystals are safe.
dave.failed: Crystal reserves bleed away. Dave orders rationing immediately.

hazard_types.description: A gravitational distortion that warps space and pulls ships off course.

status_effect.description: Gravitational pull disrupts navigation — random drift applied to movement.

aristotle.mitigated: A veteran hand steadies the helm. The singularity's pull fades behind them.
aristotle.failed: The ship lurches violently. Aristotle is thrown against the bulkhead.

dave.mitigated: Experience prevails — the crew fights free of the gravity well.
dave.failed: Gravity tears at the hull. Dave shouts orders over the groaning metal.

hazard_types.description: The expanding shockwave of a dead star — intense radiation and debris.

status_effect.description: Residual radiation weakens hull plating — next hazard damage increased by 50%.

aristotle.mitigated: The shields strain but hold. Aristotle makes a note to avoid dead stars.
aristotle.failed: Radiation scorches the hull. The ship creaks ominously.

dave.mitigated: Shielding absorbs the worst of it. Dave orders a full systems check.
dave.failed: The shockwave hits hard. Warning klaxons fill the bridge.
